objective: Prioritize complete-song representations that avoid persistent audio storage and prevent fragment-selection bias from entering Matrix X or generation readiness.

sources.name: DALI
sources.temporal_scope: dataset released 2018; candidate availability must be checked per song
sources.epistemic_use: Prototype/research only; annotation quality and ground-truth flag must be retained.

sources.name: AcousticBrainz
sources.epistemic_use: Full-track aggregate corroboration and T-layer source; not a vocal-melody substitute.

sources.name: LRCLIB
sources.epistemic_use: Text layer only; synchronized text cannot substitute for complete melody coverage.

sources.name: Apple_iTunes_preview
sources.epistemic_use: Excluded from Matrix X, cohort rules and generation readiness.

invariant: No source with PREVIEW or SHORT coverage may upgrade any TMT dimension to FULL.
